ai_summary: Affordable Robotic & Automation Limited (ARAPL) reported a significant financial turnaround for H1 FY26, achieving profitability on both standalone and consolidated bases driven by robust cost optimization and operational efficiencies. The company is making a material strategic push into warehouse automation via its HUMRO subsidiary, evidenced by an approved 80 Cr investment and strong traction with US customers. A notable aspect is the promoter's interest-free loan of 26 Cr to fund the subsidiary, secured by selling his stake to HNIs, which while explained, presents a unique funding structure.
